description: Edit this sheet of six small chibi pixel art figures sitting on the ground: in the top row one sits facing the viewer, one sits facing away from the viewer, one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the chest; in the bottom row one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the mouth and two sit facing away. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a vampire countess's: a black ankle-length bell gown with one broad crimson panel down its front, a fitted waist, long black puffed sleeves to the wrist, a low collar kept below the chin fastened with a small silver bat clasp, and a long black cape with crimson lining hanging from the shoulders to mid-calf behind her. The gown stops just above the ankles so small black boots show. Seen from behind, the cape covers the back with its plain black outside. When sitting the gown lies over the legs and the cape folds behind the back. Nothing of the outfit reaches lower than each seated figure's own lowest pixels, which stay exactly where they are. The hands stay bare and keep their place. Transparent background, nothing else added.
